top_signals.headline: Bank Indonesia Holds BI-Rate at 5.75% to Support Rupiah Stability
top_signals.impact: The central bank maintained its benchmark rate amid global uncertainty, balancing growth support with currency stability. Foreign reserves remain robust at $151.8B, providing FX intervention capacity.

top_signals.headline: JCI Index Resilient Above 7,200 as Foreign Flows Turn Positive
top_signals.impact: Jakarta Composite Index maintains strength driven by banking and consumer sectors. Net foreign buying resumed as EM sentiment improves on Fed pivot expectations. YTD performance +2.3%.

top_signals.headline: Indonesia Q3 GDP Grows 5.12% YoY, Beats Consensus Estimates
top_signals.impact: Economic expansion driven by household consumption (+4.9%) and fixed investment (+5.1%). Manufacturing PMI at 52.3 signals continued expansion. Full-year growth projected at 5.05-5.15%.

top_signals.headline: Federal Reserve Signals Potential December Rate Cut Amid Cooling Inflation
top_signals.impact: FOMC minutes suggest committee members see conditions for further easing. Core PCE trending toward 2.5% target. Markets pricing 65% probability of 25bp cut in December.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Rupiah Stabilizes at 15,850/USD on Trade Surplus
top_signals.impact: Currency finds support from continued trade surplus ($10.5B Q3) and BI intervention. Carry trade dynamics remain favorable vs USD. Key resistance at 16,000 level.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Banks Report Strong NIM Expansion in Q3 Results
top_signals.impact: Major banks (BBCA, BBRI, BMRI) posted 12-15% earnings growth with NIMs expanding to 5.2-5.8%. Loan growth accelerated to 11.5% YoY. NPL ratios stable at 2.1-2.4%.

top_signals.headline: S&P 500 Approaches All-Time High on AI Optimism and Rate Cut Bets
top_signals.impact: Index trading near 6,000 level as tech sector leads. Magnificent 7 stocks contribute 60% of YTD gains. Earnings growth re-accelerating to +8% YoY in Q4.

top_signals.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls to 4.35% on Dovish Fed Outlook
top_signals.impact: Bond yields decline as markets reprice Fed trajectory. Real yields at +2.0% remain attractive for fixed income allocations. Duration positioning shifts to neutral.

top_signals.headline: China Manufacturing PMI Expands to 51.5, Supporting EM Sentiment
top_signals.impact: Factory activity strengthens on stimulus measures and export recovery. Positive read-through for Asian supply chains and commodity demand. EM currencies rally.

top_signals.headline: Brent Crude Holds at $78/bbl as OPEC+ Maintains Production Discipline
top_signals.impact: Oil prices stabilize on balanced supply-demand outlook. OPEC+ compliance remains high at 95%. Inventory levels normalize. Range-bound trading expected near term.

top_signals.headline: Mortgage demand drops nearly 10% to end 2025, despite lower interest rates
top_signals.impact: The Mortgage Bankers Association's seasonally adjusted index reported a 9.7% drop in total mortgage applications despite decreased mortgage rates.

top_signals.headline: Eurozone inflation falls to 2% in December
top_signals.impact: Economists polled by FT do not expect interest rate cut this year

top_signals.headline: CNBC launches CNBC Cures to help 30 million Americans with rare diseases
top_signals.impact: CNBC Cures aims to raise awareness of rare diseases. Led by "Squawk Box" anchor Becky Quick, CNBC Cures was inspired by her family's own rare disease journey.

top_signals.headline: Family office deals cooled off in December, but heirs placed bets in health and media
top_signals.impact: Investment firms of the ultra-rich didn't jump into the M&A frenzy during the holiday season.

top_signals.headline: Real estate agents say the housing market is starting to balance out
top_signals.impact: The latest housing survey shows agents slightly more optimistic about the new year, and shows a previously strong buyer's market becoming more balanced.

top_signals.headline: Ford enters race to offer eyes-off driving tech, starting with $30,000 EV in 2028
top_signals.impact: The target brings Ford into a race against competitors such as Tesla, General Motors and Rivian Automotive to develop and broadly launch such systems.

top_signals.headline: JPMorgan Chase reaches deal to become Apple Card issuer as Goldman closes chapter on consumer foray
top_signals.impact: JPMorgan Chase has reached a deal to take over the Apple credit card from Goldman Sachs, the two banks said late Wednesday.

top_signals.headline: Alaska Airlines to buy more than 100 Boeing jets in carrier's biggest order ever
top_signals.impact: Alaska Airlines orders 105 Boeing 737 Max 10s and five 787-10 Dreamliners in carrier's biggest order ever.

top_signals.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang would have to pay about $8 billion in proposed billionaire tax—he says that's 'perfectly fine' with him
top_signals.impact: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has an estimated net worth of $166 billion, according to Forbes. A 5% tax on those assets would result in a bill over $8 billion.

top_signals.impact: Shares of Club names CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks were each up roughly 5% in the third session of an early 2026 rally.

top_signals.impact: Upstart airline Avelo said it would stop flying deportation flights for ICE, citing unpredictable revenue and added costs.

top_signals.headline: RFK Jr. announces new nutrition guidelines, pushing more protein and less processed food
top_signals.impact: Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins announced new nutrition guidelines.

top_signals.impact: American Airlines is keeping frequent flyer status requirements the same for a third consecutive year.
